signals.name: Mobile Lighthouse Performance
signals.rationale: Directly impacts mobile bounce rate and ad quality score.

signals.name: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
signals.rationale: Core Web Vital measuring perceived loading speed.

signals.name: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
signals.rationale: Measures visual stability to avoid accidental misclicks.

signals.name: Mobile Viewport Configuration
signals.rationale: Essential for responsive rendering across devices.

signals.name: Hero Headline Structure
signals.rationale: Page must feature a single clear H1 heading in the hero.

signals.name: Clear Problem Statement
signals.rationale: Visitor must immediately understand what friction is being solved.

signals.name: Measurable Benefit / Outcome
signals.rationale: Vague claims fail; concrete metrics build conviction.

signals.name: Plain Language vs. Buzzwords
signals.rationale: Penalizes empty corporate buzzwords lacking substance.

signals.name: Primary CTA in Hero
signals.rationale: Visitors must see the primary action without scrolling.

signals.name: Action-Oriented CTA Labeling
signals.rationale: Specific verbs (Book, Watch, Start) convert better than Submit/Click.

signals.name: Lead Capture Engine Integration
signals.rationale: Detects native forms and dynamic modal triggers like HubSpot.

signals.name: Clarity of Next Step
signals.rationale: Sets expectation of what happens after click (e.g. 15-min demo vs instant trial).

signals.name: Enterprise Customer Logos
signals.rationale: Establishes institutional credibility and category validation.

signals.name: Security & Compliance (SOC2 / ISO / HIPAA)
signals.rationale: Crucial trust gate for enterprise IT/HR decision-makers.

signals.name: Quantified Case Study Evidence
signals.rationale: Specific proof (e.g. 70% resolution, 45 days) drives high-ticket conversion.
